data.title: Invoice – Wallbox installation (Elektro Beispielfunke)
data.summary: Elektro Beispielfunke GmbH invoices Anton Musterschmidt €1,792.14 for installing an 11 kW wallbox charging station at his garage (work carried out 13 October 2026), payable within 8 days of the invoice date, 16 October 2026.
data.explanation: This is an invoice from an electrician for installing an EV charging station (Wallbox) in your garage, totalling €1,792.14 including VAT. Pay it by the deadline shown, which is counted from the invoice date, by transferring the amount to the IBAN given and citing the invoice number as reference. German VAT law asks you to keep this invoice for at least two years. Since this is a craftsman service (Handwerkerleistung), part of the labour cost (not materials) may be tax-deductible under §35a EStG — consider mentioning it in your next tax return (Steuererklärung) or asking a tax advisor if unsure.
